key_terms.الْمُبِينُ: The clear, manifest, or evident one

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Bala' Al-Mubin' in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific command given to Ibrahim (AS) to sacrifice his son Ismail (AS), representing the ultimate test of submission (taqwa) and readiness to surrender one's most beloved possession to God. The term 'balā' mubīn' (clear trial) underscores the clarity of the divine command amidst the emotional weight of the event, a narrative central to the concept of Imamate and leadership through trial. This event is commemorated in Shia tradition as a precursor to the sacrifice of Imam Husayn (AS), illustrating the continuity of the test of faith across generations of the Ahl al-Bayt.
